title: The GitHub Blog

items.title: Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering
items.content:
Writing code got faster. The work around it didn't. See how you can plan, write code, review changes, and investigate production issues with GitHub Copilot, and what work still needs your judgment.

The post Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Writing code got faster. The work around it didn't. See how you can plan, write code, review changes, and investigate production issues with GitHub Copilot, and what work still needs your judgment.
The post Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Nick Liffen

summaries.zh: 文章《超越代码生成：开发者指南：智能工程》介绍了如何使用GitHub Copilot进行计划、编写代码、审查变更和调查生产问题。尽管代码生成速度加快，但相关工作仍需开发者判断。文章探讨了智能工程如何提升开发效率，并指出当前仍需人工干预的部分。
summaries.en: The article "Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering" discusses how tools like GitHub Copilot can accelerate coding tasks but still require developer oversight for planning, reviewing changes, and addressing production issues. It highlights the need for human judgment in the engineering process despite advancements in code generation. The piece appears on The GitHub Blog.

items.summary: 文章《超越代码生成：开发者指南：智能工程》介绍了如何使用GitHub Copilot进行计划、编写代码、审查变更和调查生产问题。尽管代码生成速度加快，但相关工作仍需开发者判断。文章探讨了智能工程如何提升开发效率，并指出当前仍需人工干预的部分。

items.title: Inside GitHub’s new Git storage architecture
items.content:
GitHub's new Git storage architecture is built so thousands of agents can push to a single repository at once. Here's how it works.

The post Inside GitHub’s new Git storage architecture appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
GitHub's new Git storage architecture is built so thousands of agents can push to a single repository at once. Here's how it works.
The post Inside GitHub’s new Git storage architecture appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Karthik Raman

summaries.zh: GitHub推出新Git存储架构，旨在支持成千上万的代理同时向单个仓库推送。该架构通过优化数据同步和存储机制，提高了并发处理能力，确保大规模协作场景下的性能和稳定性。
summaries.en: GitHub has introduced a new Git storage architecture designed to handle simultaneous pushes from thousands of agents to a single repository. The system enhances scalability and performance by optimizing how data is stored and accessed. This update aims to improve efficiency and reliability for large-scale repositories. The new architecture is detailed in a post on The GitHub Blog.

items.summary: GitHub推出新Git存储架构，旨在支持成千上万的代理同时向单个仓库推送。该架构通过优化数据同步和存储机制，提高了并发处理能力，确保大规模协作场景下的性能和稳定性。

items.title: Accessibility statements now have a home on GitHub
items.content:
GitHub now highlights ACCESSIBILITY.md files and helps maintainers document accessibility goals, known barriers, supported environments, contributor expectations, and reporting processes.

The post Accessibility statements now have a home on GitHub appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
GitHub now highlights ACCESSIBILITY.md files and helps maintainers document accessibility goals, known barriers, supported environments, contributor expectations, and reporting processes.
The post Accessibility statements now have a home on GitHub appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Jan Maarten

summaries.zh: GitHub现支持在GitHub上突出显示ACCESSIBILITY.md文件，帮助维护者记录无障碍性目标、已知障碍、支持环境、贡献者期望和报告流程。该功能旨在提升项目的无障碍性管理。
summaries.en: GitHub now features accessibility statements in its GitHub Archive, highlighting ACCESSIBILITY.md files. This feature assists maintainers in documenting accessibility goals, barriers, supported environments, contributor expectations, and reporting processes. The initiative centralizes accessibility information, improving transparency and maintenance. The announcement was made on The GitHub Blog.

items.title: Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT
items.content:
GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year! This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT. Change gears, swap perspectives, bend reality, or just press a certain key.

The post Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year! This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT. Change gears, swap perspectives, bend reality, or just press a certain key.
The post Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Lee Reilly

summaries.zh: GitHub的年度为期一个月的游戏马拉松第14届即将回归。今年11月，以“SHIFT”为主题进行创作。参赛者需围绕转变、交换视角、扭曲现实或按键触发等灵感设计游戏。活动详情请参考GitHub博客。
summaries.en: Game Off 2026, GitHub's 14th annual game jam, is returning for a month-long event in November. The theme is "SHIFT," encouraging participants to create games that explore changing perspectives, altering reality, or simple interactive shifts. The event invites creativity around the concept of transformation in gaming.

items.title: Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents
items.content:
See how a record year of growth reached every industry, every field, and every kind of builder in the 2026 Octoverse report.

The post Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
See how a record year of growth reached every industry, every field, and every kind of builder in the 2026 Octoverse report.
The post Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: GitHub Staff

summaries.zh: 2026年Octoverse报告显示，开发者的提交、推送量创下新高，各行各业和各类构建者均实现显著增长。报告强调，开发者借助智能代理进行高效构建，推动技术发展。这一记录增长反映了GitHub平台的广泛影响力，并展示了开发者社区的创新活力。
summaries.en: The 2026 Octoverse report highlights a record year of growth, with commits, pushes, and milestones reaching new highs. Developers across all industries utilized agents to build, demonstrating widespread adoption. The report emphasizes the impact of this trend on various fields and types of builders. The growth reflects the increasing integration of agent-based development in the tech ecosystem.

items.title: The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure
items.content:
We moved a copy of 99.99999% of GitHub's repositories to Azure. Here's how per-reference quorums will bring over the rest, and how object storage lets reads scale independently.

The post The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
We moved a copy of 99.99999% of GitHub's repositories to Azure. Here's how per-reference quorums will bring over the rest, and how object storage lets reads scale independently.
The post The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Eleanor White

summaries.zh: 我们已将 GitHub 99.99999% 的仓库迁移至 Azure。本文介绍了如何通过参考级别多数投票机制（per-reference quorums）迁移剩余部分，以及如何利用对象存储实现读写分离的扩展。文章来源：GitHub 博客。
summaries.en: We migrated 99.99999% of GitHub's repositories to Azure. The remaining 0.00001% will be transferred using per-reference quorums. Object storage enables independent scaling of reads. The details were first published on The GitHub Blog.

items.summary: 我们已将 GitHub 99.99999% 的仓库迁移至 Azure。本文介绍了如何通过参考级别多数投票机制（per-reference quorums）迁移剩余部分，以及如何利用对象存储实现读写分离的扩展。文章来源：GitHub 博客。
